title: Surrender a company or partnership contractor licence
summary: Learn how to cancel and return a company or partnership contractor licence to Fair Trading if your business is retiring, dissolving, or changing.
intro:
If you hold a company or partnership contractor licence and the business is retiring, dissolving or changing, the licence will need to be cancelled and returned to Fair Trading. This can be done at a Service NSW Centre.

You may be entitled to a partial refund for the unexpired portion of the fee you paid for the licence.
who_can_apply: Hold a company or partnership contractor licence
The business is retiring, dissolving, or changing
what_you_need: Your licence card and licence number

how_to_steps.text: Visit a service centre with your licence card and submit the documentation in person.

faqs.q: What should I do if my business is retiring or dissolving?
faqs.a: If you hold a company or partnership contractor licence and the business is retiring, dissolving or changing, the licence must be cancelled and returned to Fair Trading.

faqs.q: Do I need to bring any documents to cancel my licence?
faqs.a: You need your licence card and licence number, and the PDF form titled 'Surrender of Licence/Certificate'.

faqs.q: Where can I surrender my licence?
faqs.a: You can cancel and return the licence at a Service NSW Centre.
